summary: Profile and settings for any game: name and ID, sound, volume and motion, language, tutorials, log out and account deletion.
description: A ready profile screen (Unity Alikhan/Username, UI/HUD/Settings, Runtime/UI/Consent, Localization) for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit. The player's name (rename in a popup with the server's rules: 3–24 characters, trimmed) and ID with copy; settings: sound on/off, volume and 'fewer animations' — the kit's player prefs, kept on this device and applied to every screen at once — the game's language (the title's languages, when there are two or more). Buttons: Tutorials (when tutorials is installed), Log out (confirmed) and Delete account — a popup that unlocks only after the player types the confirmation word, then deletes this game's data for the player. Registers the 'profile' feature; the lobby's profile button opens it. No title settings needed.
